property_summary: For any caller and any timestamp, once C has received 10 ether at time t, any further 10-ether deposit at the same time t must revert (pastBlockTime requires block.timestamp > pastBlockTime); the mutant deletes this check so a second same-timestamp deposit succeeds, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) check, allowing multiple calls within the same timestamp.
